[[File:Isolder-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|200px|Isolder was the consort of Teneniel Djo]]
'''Consort''' was a title used among [[Hapan]] royalty and nobility to denote the [[Gender/Legends|male]] sexual partner of a Hapan female. The role of consort was equivalent to the role of [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], but due to Hapan culture, the female was the dominant one in the partnership, and the consorts were sometimes treated as little more than [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].

[[Isolder]] was the consort of [[Teneniel Djo]], and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] was briefly referred to among some Hapan [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] as [[Tenel Ka Djo]]'s consort during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]].
